test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are marked from U to Z. Select the letter that will be on the face opposite to the one showing 'X' .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25a4c26ed1d99a2328d1cd0318ca859759c8aaffbf9eb21da1b7d92675be77af.png]
solution:
When two same dice, having 2 common digits/alphabets showing on the two faces, then the third (different)faces are opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/deff408b5a6ee2050e3a7dd78f9d39e449c2cb41f0e91721cc82da68d6bb23ba.png] 

Therefore, **'W' will be on the face opposite to 'X'**

Hence, the correct answer is** option(4)**
